notes: Join pages: capture a second page and the editor offers to join it with the one you just captured - side by side, both URL bars in one row, every mark still editable, and the file name keeps both page names. Ctrl+Z or Undo join takes it apart again. The Join button (J) also takes a page from another open capture, a dropped or chosen image file, or Ctrl+V. Also: Crop can be undone, turning the URL bar on or off no longer changes the capture time, editor tabs are named after their page, and a URL bar hidden under Blur or White out is no longer a clickable link in the PDF. update.cmd now updates exactly like Update now.
